title: Verify European clan alias during Bank entry
changes: Establish ordinary European Bank-entry use of the managed clan graphics table alias and compare the corresponding scene.
validation: A source-backed Wine audit of the retained 120-frame Bank entry records two typed four-byte alias reads, one at original interpreter instruction 0805e73a, with no dropped or truncated events.

A separate Wine pair using the same state, input, dataset and native cache matches all 120 complete states, clocks, central and wide images, OAM, dispatch and five audio outputs; 93 protected inputs and 688 frozen source hashes remain unchanged.
limitations: This covers one selected Bank entry and shared native cache, not every path, language or full helper ABI. Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified; no performance measurement.
